concerns: The proposed Malaysian form does not provide a reliable contrast because meningkatkan is also ordinary Malaysian Malay for improving something.
response.cue_rationale: Both answers express the transitive sense of making something better.
material_concerns: The pairing may mislead learners into treating meningkatkan as Indonesian-only; Malaysian Malay commonly uses meningkatkan for the same sense.

preference_risk.rationale: meningkatkan is ordinary for this sense in Indonesian and can also be used in Malaysian Malay, weakening the claimed preference.

response.rationale: Both forms fit “to make something better,” but the claimed national preference is weakened by shared everyday use of meningkatkan in Malaysian Malay. memperbaik is a valid Malaysian form, yet the contrast is not dependable.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: meningkatkan is also an ordinary Malaysian alternative for improving something, so everyday usage can defeat the proposed Indonesian–Malaysian contrast.
